title: ReviewCreated.v1
description: Emitted when a new review is created, including the selected templates and subject.

subjectId.description: ID of the subject being reviewed (product ID or team ID depending on subjectType).
subjectId.markdownDescription: ID of the subject being reviewed (product ID or team ID depending on subjectType).

subjectType.description: Whether this review is scoped to a product or a team.
subjectType.markdownDescription: Whether this review is scoped to a product or a team.

templateIds.description: Ordered list of template IDs selected for this review at creation time.
templateIds.markdownDescription: Ordered list of template IDs selected for this review at creation time.

scope.description: Scope chosen in the review wizard: 'team' for team-level only, 'application' for selected apps, 'product' for the full product.
scope.markdownDescription: Scope chosen in the review wizard: 'team' for team-level only, 'application' for selected apps, 'product' for the full product.

applicationIds.description: Application IDs in scope. Empty array when scope is 'team' or 'product'.
applicationIds.markdownDescription: Application IDs in scope. Empty array when scope is 'team' or 'product'.

teamIds.description: Team IDs associated with this review at creation time.
teamIds.markdownDescription: Team IDs associated with this review at creation time.
